using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsError_WhenAddressIsNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<ICurrentConfig>(MockBehavior.Strict);

            // Setup clusterProvider to return a clusterManager with CurrentConfig
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(m => m.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);

            // Setup CurrentConfig.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId to return (null, -1) to trigger error log
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns((null, -1));

            // Setup other dependencies minimally
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.replicationManager).Returns(Mock.Of<IReplicationManager>());
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(Mock.Of<IServerOptions>());
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.ClusterUsername).Returns("user");
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.ClusterPassword).Returns("pass");

            var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
                storeWrapper: Mock.Of<StoreWrapper>(),
                clusterProvider: mockClusterProvider.Object,
                replicaNodeId: "replica1",
                logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await session.SendCheckpointAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("PRIMARY-ERR don't know about replicaId")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsError_WhenSyncFromAofAddressLessThanBeginAddress()
        {
            // This test will simulate the condition on line 301 where LogError is called
            // We need to mock dependencies to cause syncFromAofAddress < storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress
            // and possibleAofDataLoss == false

            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<IReplicationManager>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<ICurrentConfig>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>(MockBehavior.Strict);

            // Setup clusterProvider to return clusterManager and replicationManager
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions
            {
                UseAofNullDevice = false,
                FastAofTruncate = true,
                OnDemandCheckpoint = true,
                ReplicaSyncTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)
            });
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.ClusterUsername).Returns("user");
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.ClusterPassword).Returns("pass");

            // Setup CurrentConfig.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId to return valid IP and port
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(m => m.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(("127.0.0.1", 1234));

            // Setup storeWrapper appendOnlyFile BeginAddress to 100
            mockAppendOnlyFile.SetupGet(a => a.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(s => s.appendOnlyFile).Returns(mockAppendOnlyFile.Object);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(mockClusterProvider.Object.serverOptions);

            // Setup replicationManager PrimaryReplId
            mockReplicationManager.SetupGet(r => r.PrimaryReplId).Returns("primaryReplId");

            // Setup replicationManager TryAddReplicationTask and TryConnectToReplica to return true
            mockReplicationManager.Setup(r => r.TryAddReplicationTask(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<long>(), out It.Ref<AofSyncTaskInfo>.IsAny)).Returns(true);
            mockReplicationManager.Setup(r => r.TryConnectToReplica(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<long>(), It.IsAny<AofSyncTaskInfo>(), out It.Ref<object>.IsAny)).Returns(true);

            // Setup GarnetClientSession to simulate ExecuteBeginReplicaRecover returning a string "50" (less than BeginAddress 100)
            var mockGarnetClientSession = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>(MockBehavior.Strict,
                new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Parse("127.0.0.1"), 1234),
                null, null, null, "user", "pass", mockLogger.Object);
            mockGarnetClientSession.Setup(g => g.ConnectAsync(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            mockGarnetClientSession.Setup(g => g.ExecuteBeginReplicaRecover(
                It.IsAny<bool>(), It.IsAny<bool>(), It.IsAny<bool>(), It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<long>(), It.IsAny<long>())).Returns(Task.FromResult("50"));

            // We cannot inject the GarnetClientSession directly, so we will subclass ReplicaSyncSession to override the creation of GarnetClientSession
            var session = new TestReplicaSyncSession(
                mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                replicaNodeId: "replica1",
                logger: mockLogger.Object,
                garnetClientSession: mockGarnetClientSession.Object);

            // Setup AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync to return a valid localEntry and null AofSyncTaskInfo
            session.SetAcquireCheckpointEntryAsyncReturnValue(new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
                {
                    storePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                    storeVersion = 1,
                    objectStorePrimaryReplId = "objPrimaryReplId",
                    objectStoreVersion = 1,
                    storeHlogToken = 1,
                    objectStoreHlogToken = 1
                }
            }, null);

            // Setup ValidateMetadata to return true immediately
            session.SetValidateMetadataReturnValue(true);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => session.SendCheckpointAsync());

            Assert.Contains("Failed syncing because replica requested truncated AOF address", ex.Message);

            mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("syncFromAofAddress: 50 < beginAofAddress: 100")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()), Times.Once);

            mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogCheckpointEntry(LogLevel.Error, "Requested replay address truncated", It.IsAny<CheckpointEntry>()), Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper subclass to override GarnetClientSession creation and other internals for testing
        private class TestReplicaSyncSession : ReplicaSyncSession
        {
            private readonly GarnetClientSession _garnetClientSession;
            private CheckpointEntry _localEntry;
            private AofSyncTaskInfo _aofSyncTaskInfo;
            private bool _validateMetadataReturn;

            public TestReplicaSyncSession(StoreWrapper storeWrapper, ClusterProvider clusterProvider, string replicaNodeId, ILogger logger, GarnetClientSession garnetClientSession)
                : base(storeWrapper, clusterProvider, replicaNodeId: replicaNodeId, logger: logger)
            {
                _garnetClientSession = garnetClientSession;
            }

            public void SetAcquireCheckpointEntryAsyncReturnValue(CheckpointEntry localEntry, AofSyncTaskInfo aofSyncTaskInfo)
            {
                _localEntry = localEntry;
                _aofSyncTaskInfo = aofSyncTaskInfo;
            }

            public void SetValidateMetadataReturnValue(bool returnValue)
            {
                _validateMetadataReturn = returnValue;
            }

            protected override Task<(CheckpointEntry, AofSyncTaskInfo)> AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult((_localEntry, _aofSyncTaskInfo));
            }

            protected override bool ValidateMetadata(CheckpointEntry localEntry, out long index_size, out LogFileInfo hlog_size, out long obj_index_size, out LogFileInfo obj_hlog_size, out bool skipLocalMainStoreCheckpoint, out bool skipLocalObjectStoreCheckpoint)
            {
                index_size = 0;
                hlog_size = default;
                obj_index_size = 0;
                obj_hlog_size = default;
                skipLocalMainStoreCheckpoint = false;
                skipLocalObjectStoreCheckpoint = false;
                return _validateMetadataReturn;
            }

            protected override GarnetClientSession CreateGarnetClientSession(IPEndPoint endpoint)
            {
                return _garnetClientSession;
            }
        }
    }
}
